tickets.title: Lock the modular snap grid (2m or 4m)
tickets.description: Consistent socket heights and door widths. Every exception costs tenfold later. Week-one decision.

tickets.title: Dungeon mission graph generator
tickets.description: Gate, key, challenge, reward, shortcut, reveal, climax. Build the mission BEFORE the space. Reuses the quest graph-rewriting engine.

tickets.title: Mission-to-space embedding
tickets.description: Assign each node a room type and depth respecting gate ordering.

tickets.title: 3D layout and connection routing
tickets.description: Place rooms, route connections, insert stairs and drops.

tickets.title: Mandatory verticality constraints
tickets.description: Require N level changes; stairs and shafts as first-class connectors. A flat 3D dungeon reads as a maze.

tickets.title: Open shafts giving sightlines between floors
tickets.description: Seeing a room you will reach later is the cheapest orientation aid available.

tickets.title: Hub rooms and unlockable shortcuts as graph nodes
tickets.description: Generated first-class, not decoration. The Souls solution to getting lost in 3D.

tickets.title: Unique visual anchor per branch
tickets.description: A broken statue, a collapsed roof, a colour — so branches are distinguishable by memory rather than minimap.

tickets.title: Guide lighting toward the objective
tickets.description: Subtle brightness and warmth gradient. Cannot bake lighting for generated spaces, so it must be generated.

tickets.title: Corridor length caps and forced variation
tickets.description: Long corridors are free to generate and miserable to walk — the clearest tell a space was generated.

tickets.title: Dungeon validation: reachability, gate order, no soft-locks
tickets.description: Plus encounter budget within range.

tickets.title: Kit 1: crypt (30-50 modules)
tickets.description: Room shells, corridors, junctions, stairs, shafts, doors, plus damage and clutter variants.

tickets.title: Kit 2: mine (30-50 modules)
tickets.description: Second ship kit.

tickets.title: Kit 3: ruin (30-50 modules)
tickets.description: Third ship kit. Ship with three; each additional kit multiplies against every layout already authored.

tickets.title: Kits 4-6: cave, fortification, axiom-specific
tickets.description: Post-ship content updates. Drowned polis under Deukalion's Flood; sealed telesterion under Demeter's Grief.

tickets.title: Author 10-15 landmark dungeons as normal UE levels
tickets.description: Hand-placed encounters, baked lighting, real architectural intent. Placed procedurally by the seed. These are the peaks.

tickets.title: Author 30-50 regional dungeon layout skeletons
tickets.description: Shape, vertical structure and shortcut topology by hand; dressing, encounters and loot generated. ~70% quality for ~20% authoring.

tickets.title: Minor site generator (100+ sites, 5-10 min each)
tickets.description: Caves, camps, cellars, wrecks, watchtowers. Their job is making the wilderness worth crossing.

tickets.title: Forge dungeon layouts at phase 11, instantiate on entry
tickets.description: The quest binder must reference specific chambers at generation time. Store only deltas.

tickets.title: Reverb presets from computed room volume and kit material
tickets.description: A lookup, not a simulation, stamped at dungeon-forge time. Doc 12.

tickets.title: Lumen performance budget for generated interiors
tickets.description: The main perf risk here and another reason to keep procedural sites small.
